results.backend: mock adapter (fixed delay); measurement of the orchestration layer only
results.path: backend.orchestrator.runner.execute_run with backend.database (SQLite, WAL) and artifact writing to a temporary workspace

definitions.overhead_ms_per_iteration: (run wall time - union of the run's adapter-call intervals) / iterations
definitions.overhead_upper_ms_per_iteration: (run wall time - iterations x mock delay) / iterations (counts all event-loop contention as overhead)
definitions.throughput_iters_per_s: iterations completed in a batch / batch wall time
definitions.latency_s: wall time of one execute_run call
definitions.cpu_ms_per_iteration: process CPU time (all threads) during the batch / iterations
definitions.percentiles: nearest rank over all runs of all repeats at a level
